rows.name: Used cars and trucks
rows.liveDriver: SETA02 SA model: rho 0.47 * prior CPI SA +0.67 pp + Manheim m2 signal -0.24 pp * volatility scale 0.35 + level gap z=-0.46, mean-reversion adj +0.01 pp; timing m0 2026-10 unavailable in Manheim feed; m2 2026-08 -0.85% pub 2026-09-07; omitted unavailable m0. Compared against CUSR0000SETA02; no asymmetry term kept. SA forecast converted to NSA using the component's historical SA/NSA offset.
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average

rows.name: Fuel oil
rows.liveDriver: EIA New York Harbor No. 2 heating oil spot calendar-month average $4.666/gal vs prior $4.786/gal using 14 daily prints; fitted retail pass-through beta 0.505 on 129 prior months; NSA forecast -1.27%
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average

rows.name: Other motor fuels
